decisions.title: The overall zoom
decisions.question: Should every video show a little more around the rider than today? Your proposal: 7.5% more at the closest moments of a zoom lane, 5% more at the widest.
decisions.today: production stays at today's zoom; the showcase and then-and-now films use the proposal.
decisions.mine: adopt 7.5% / 5%. You proposed it after watching the Tiki films and loved the films made with it; it is one line in the renderer, and every later video follows.

decisions.title: Trimming unused track
decisions.question: The compiler ends each curve at the rider's last touch ("End only"). Should it trim more: also before the first touch, or keep a piece or two past the touches?
decisions.mine: stay with End only. The start of a curve is what announces where the rider will land; you chose End only after comparing, and said you were not sure about more.

decisions.question: The branch master is from May; everything since lives on visual-lab. When you call the project closed, should visual-lab become master?
decisions.mine: yes, once the decisions above are applied: one branch to come back to, and the compiler agent branches from it.

decisions.title: The lab's old round pages
decisions.question: The visual lab holds about fifty judging rounds (pages, candidates, films, agent notes): around 150 tracked files that still load. Your answers to them are in the ledger and in memory.
decisions.mine: tag the commit and remove them from the tree, keeping the pages in use (the lab itself, hit movement, zoom, trim, rate, collection, showcase, these boards). The tree gets much lighter and nothing is lost: the tag brings any round back.

decisions.title: Old branches and worktrees
decisions.question: 25 local branches besides visual-lab, most of them backups and experiments from before November 15, plus agent worktrees and 1.6 GB of comparison worktrees. May I delete them?
decisions.mine: delete the 10 whose work is already in visual-lab and all worktrees; push the 15 others to the server under archive/ first, then delete them locally. Nothing is lost and the list becomes readable.
